# Spill. café website rules

1. The café name is "Spill." and it appears in the header of every page.
2. Colours: cream background #FFF8F0, soft beige cards #F3E5D0, caramel buttons and headings #C8875A, cocoa-brown text #5C3D2E, blush-pink accents #F6D6D0.
3. Fonts: Pacifico for the café name only, Nunito for all other text, both loaded from Google Fonts.
4. The menu has five sections, in this order: Pastries, Sweet Tooth, Sandwiches & Paninis, Pasta, Drinks.
5. Pastries lists croissants, tarts, puff pastry and muffins. Sweet Tooth lists brownies, cookies and cakes.
6. Drinks lists hot coffee and tea, iced drinks and milkshakes.
7. Every item has an emoji icon before its name: 🥐 croissant and puff pastry, 🥧 tart, 🧁 muffin, 🍫 brownie, 🍪 cookie, 🍰 cake, 🥪 sandwich, 🧀 panini, 🍝 pasta, ☕ hot drink, 🧋 iced drink, 🥤 milkshake.
8. Each item is shown as a rounded beige card with its icon, name, a one-line description and its price.
9. Prices are in Pakistani rupees with a comma for thousands, for example Rs 1,250.
10. index.html has, in order: a hero with the café name, a short tagline and the photo cafe.jpg; the menu; an About section; and an "Order now" button linking to order.html.
11. order.html lists every item with a quantity box, shows a running total in Rs, and has a form for name, pickup time and an 11-digit phone number, with an error message if the number is not 11 digits.
12. Never use dark backgrounds anywhere on the site.
